title: Samples per coefficient for a finite family
statement: Let $\mathcal F$ be a nonempty finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $\varepsilon$ be rational with $0<\varepsilon\leq\tfrac12$. The number of samples per coefficient is the Fourier estimator sample count at accuracy $\varepsilon/(2|\mathcal F|)$ and confidence $1/(10|\mathcal F|)$, where $|\mathcal F|$ denotes the cardinality of $\mathcal F$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal F$ is a finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
